CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vinops.can_access_document_scope(p_project_id uuid, p_discipline_id uuid, p_classification_id uuid, p_work_id uuid, p_action text DEFAULT 'read'::text, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT vinops.current_actor_id())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'vinops', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT vinops.can_access_project(p_project_id, p_user_id)
     AND CASE
       WHEN p_discipline_id IS NULL AND p_classification_id IS NULL AND p_work_id IS NULL
         THEN vinops.can_read_scoped_resource(p_project_id, 'project', p_project_id, p_action, p_user_id)
       ELSE
         (p_discipline_id IS NULL OR vinops.can_read_scoped_resource(p_project_id, 'discipline', p_discipline_id, p_action, p_user_id))
         AND (p_classification_id IS NULL OR vinops.can_read_scoped_resource(p_project_id, 'classification', p_classification_id, p_action, p_user_id))
         AND (p_work_id IS NULL OR vinops.can_read_scoped_resource(p_project_id, 'work', p_work_id, p_action, p_user_id))
     END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vinops.can_access_document(p_document_id uuid, p_action text DEFAULT 'read'::text, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT vinops.current_actor_id())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'vinops', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM vinops.documents document
     WHERE document.id = p_document_id
       AND vinops.can_access_document_scope(
         document.project_id,
         document.discipline_id,
         document.classification_id,
         document.work_id,
         p_action,
         p_user_id
       )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vinops.can_access_project(p_project_id uuid, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT vinops.current_actor_id())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'vinops', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
      FROM vinops.projects project
     WHERE project.id = p_project_id
       AND (
         vinops.is_active_project_member(project.id, p_user_id)
         OR vinops.has_organization_role(project.organization_id, 'organization_owner', p_user_id)
         OR vinops.has_organization_role(project.organization_id, 'security_admin', p_user_id)
       )
  );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vinops.can_read_scoped_resource(p_project_id uuid, p_scope_type text, p_scope_id uuid, p_action text DEFAULT 'read'::text, p_user_id uuid DEFAULT vinops.current_actor_id())
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'vinops', 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT
    vinops.can_manage_project_context(p_project_id, p_user_id)
    OR EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
        FROM vinops.member_scopes scope
        JOIN vinops.project_members membership ON membership.id = scope.project_member_id
       WHERE scope.project_id = p_project_id
         AND membership.project_id = p_project_id
         AND membership.user_id = p_user_id
         AND membership.status = 'Active'
         AND (membership.valid_from IS NULL OR membership.valid_from <= now())
         AND (membership.valid_to IS NULL OR membership.valid_to > now())
         AND scope.revoked_at IS NULL
         AND (scope.valid_from IS NULL OR scope.valid_from <= now())
         AND (scope.valid_to IS NULL OR scope.valid_to > now())
         AND p_action = ANY(scope.actions)
         AND (
           scope.scope_type = 'project'
           OR (scope.scope_type = p_scope_type AND scope.scope_id = p_scope_id)
         )
    );
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION vinops.current_actor_id()
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
AS $function$
  SELECT NULLIF(current_setting('app.user_id', true), '')::uuid;
$function$
